meta.generatedFrom: TypeScript (the parity contract — never regenerate from Rust)
meta.description: clamp(−CROWD_VALUATION_GAIN·s + CROWD_MOMENTUM_GAIN·momentum, ±CROWD_LEAN_CAP) over a full cross product of boundary inputs.
notes: No transcendentals — two multiplies, one add, one clamp. This should port bit-exactly with no libm involvement at all, which makes it the best canary: if this file fails, the problem is structural, not a last-ULP libm difference.
The unary minus is applied to the CONSTANT (`-CROWD_VALUATION_GAIN * s`), which for s = -0 gives +0 rather than -0.
-Infinity + Infinity yields NaN, which the clamp passes through.
meta.floatEncoding: bits = raw IEEE-754 f64, big-endian, 16 uppercase hex digits. dec = shortest round-trip decimal, informational only.
meta.nanPolicy: Every NaN is recorded as 7FF8000000000000 (the pattern of Rust f64::NAN). V8 does not emit a stable NaN sign/payload, so only NaN-ness is contractual — compare NaN results with is_nan(), not with bits.
